meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一份 DAG 定义存成命名 JSON 文件（如 nightly-audit.json），之后按名字加载并重新运行，不用每次粘贴定义。加载时会替换 {{key}}、{{date}}、{{datetime}} 占位符，并默认给 key 加 UTC 时间戳，让每次调用都是新运行。
howto.when: 当你想保存一份 DAG、按名字运行已保存的 DAG，或反复调度同一个多代理图时触发；想从零写新图要先读 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把这份 DAG 存成 nightly-audit

say.note: key 自动加 UTC 时间戳，跑一次新运行
同后缀复用旧运行，不会重复跑

howto.what_en: Stores a DAG definition as a named JSON file (e.g. nightly-audit.json), then loads and re-runs it by name instead of pasting the definition each time. On load it fills {{key}}, {{date}}, {{datetime}} placeholders and by default appends a UTC timestamp to the key so every call is a fresh run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one by name, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph. To author a brand-new graph, read mass-ulw first.

say_en.note: Key gets a UTC timestamp, so it runs fresh
Same suffix reuses the old run, no re-run
